definition: A gene encoding Snurportin-1, a nuclear transport receptor/adaptor involved in trafficking small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs) to the nucleus for spliceosome assembly. Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy 29 (LGMDR29, OMIM #620793), characterized by childhood-onset proximal limb weakness, prominent contractures, restrictive respiratory insufficiency, and myofibrillar-like features on muscle biopsy resulting from snRNP cytoplasmic accumulation and aberrant RNA splicing.

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: Snurportin-1, the protein encoded by SNUPN, plays an important role in the nuclear transport of small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs), essential components of the spliceosome.
